notes: Two fixes from the office. (1) Notifications you won't miss: when something lands while the desk is behind another window, the taskbar button now flashes until you click back — not just a toast that vanishes in a few seconds — and a standing alert waits for you on the desk. (2) Your part notes are now searchable: search finds a part by the note you wrote on it (so 'splashguard' turns it up even if the catalog says 'fillguard'), and the note shows right there in the results.
